slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots produced per fighter jet allocated to training in each year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked about the per-year pilot training capacity of each training jet, exactly matching the slot's key meaning.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the 10 jets produced in year 1 available to be allocated for training in year 2 as well, or are they consumed or unavailable after year 1?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent probed year-to-year temporal/dependency structure but never explicitly asked about the training program's start year or its duration, so the slot's key meaning was not fully covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both year 1 and year 2 and produces pilots each year, spanning the two-year horizon.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The user never confirmed the training start year or duration (all related questions returned 'needs internal confirmation'), yet the model assumes training output for both years with no explicit confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 training duration/start slot remained unresolved; multiple timeline-related questions were never answered, and the model silently assumed a two-year training timeline.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the P0 per-jet training capacity (H1) but never clarified the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping (P2) and only partially probed the training start/duration (P1), then stopped with the P1 timeline slot unresolved and silently assumed a two-year training horizon.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
